title: Why Your Body Jerks Awake Right Before You Fall Asleep
hook: That sudden falling jolt in bed, your brain caused it.

narration.text: Right before sleep, your whole body can suddenly jerk awake.
It is called a hypnic jerk, and it is completely normal.
As you drift off, your brain slows breathing and heart rate fast.
Sometimes your brain misreads that relaxing as actually falling.
It fires one last signal to your muscles, just in case.
That jolt is just your brain double checking you are safe.
It happens more when you are stressed, tired, or drink lots of caffeine.
Try noticing it tonight and tell me in the comments if it happens, like this if it has startled you, subscribe for more of your body explained, and send this to someone who always jumps awake.

description: That sudden falling feeling right as you drift off has a name and a simple explanation. It is your brain briefly misreading relaxation as danger. Here is what is actually happening in your body in those seconds before sleep.
topic: Why you might suddenly feel a jolt of 'falling' just as you are drifting off to sleep. This is a common muscle spasm.
